tls.name: Verify native toolchain
tls.script:
test "$(uname -m)" = arm64
xcodebuild -version | tee xcode-version.log
grep -q "Xcode 26.2" xcode-version.log
xcodebuild -showsdks

tls.name: Boot owned test simulator
tls.script: exec python3 "$NATIVE_CONTROL/ci/codemagic_entry.py" scripts/ci_simulator.py --receipt "$NATIVE_CONTROL/native-evidence/boot-receipt.json" --result test-simulator/result.json boot --output test-simulator --github-env "$NATIVE_SIMULATOR_ENV"

tls.name: Pairing TLS policy tests
tls.script:
source "$NATIVE_SIMULATOR_ENV"
set -euo pipefail
xcodebuild -project AsterionVeyra.xcodeproj -scheme AsterionVeyra -destination "platform=iOS Simulator,id=$SIMULATOR_ID" -destination-timeout 120 -parallel-testing-enabled NO -test-timeouts-enabled YES -default-test-execution-time-allowance 120 -maximum-test-execution-time-allowance 180 -only-testing:AsterionVeyraTests/PairedDesktopTransportTests -resultBundlePath PairingTLSResults.xcresult CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO test 2>&1 | tee pairing-tls-tests.log

tls.name: Export TLS attachments
tls.script: if [ -d PairingTLSResults.xcresult ]; then xcrun xcresulttool export attachments --path PairingTLSResults.xcresult --output-path pairing-tls-screenshots; fi

tls.name: Shut down owned test simulator before upgrade
tls.script:
if [ -f test-simulator/ownership.json ]; then
 source "$NATIVE_SIMULATOR_ENV"
exec python3 "$NATIVE_CONTROL/ci/codemagic_entry.py" scripts/ci_simulator.py --receipt "$NATIVE_CONTROL/native-evidence/shutdown-receipt.json" --result test-simulator/handoff/result.json shutdown --output test-simulator --simulator-id "$SIMULATOR_ID"
fi

native.name: Export test screenshots
native.script:
if [ -d TestResults.xcresult ]; then
  xcrun xcresulttool export attachments --path TestResults.xcresult --output-path test-screenshots
fi
if [ -d ChecklistLifecycleResults.xcresult ]; then
  xcrun xcresulttool export attachments --path ChecklistLifecycleResults.xcresult --output-path checklist-lifecycle-screenshots
fi
if [ -d ChecklistPrivacyResults.xcresult ]; then
  xcrun xcresulttool export attachments --path ChecklistPrivacyResults.xcresult --output-path checklist-privacy-screenshots
fi
if [ -d ChecklistInteractionResults.xcresult ]; then
  xcrun xcresulttool export attachments --path ChecklistInteractionResults.xcresult --output-path checklist-test-screenshots
fi

native.name: Verify encrypted Swift-to-desktop transfer
native.script:
python3 -m venv .verification-venv
.verification-venv/bin/python -m pip install -r companion/requirements-sync.txt
.verification-venv/bin/python Tests/verify_mobile_transfer.py test-screenshots
.verification-venv/bin/python -m unittest scripts.tests.test_private_memory_sync_reference -v

package.name: Verify native toolchain
package.script:
test "$(uname -m)" = arm64
xcodebuild -version | tee xcode-version.log
grep -q "Xcode 26.2" xcode-version.log
xcodebuild -showsdks

package.name: Fetch pinned upgrade baselines
package.script:
git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin 8074b807a864a79e659200ee9521141c3c00df98
test "$(git rev-parse 8074b807a864a79e659200ee9521141c3c00df98^{commit})" = 8074b807a864a79e659200ee9521141c3c00df98
git fetch --no-tags --depth=1 origin 59aa7329efa87ce01b247ca309941c20b2e3dc8d
test "$(git rev-parse 59aa7329efa87ce01b247ca309941c20b2e3dc8d^{commit})" = 59aa7329efa87ce01b247ca309941c20b2e3dc8d

package.name: Compile unsigned device app
package.script:
set -euo pipefail
xcodebuild -project AsterionVeyra.xcodeproj -scheme AsterionVeyra -configuration Release -sdk iphoneos -destination 'generic/platform=iOS' -derivedDataPath build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO MARKETING_VERSION=0.4.0 CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION=9009 build
mkdir Payload
cp -R build/Build/Products/Release-iphoneos/AsterionVeyra.app Payload/
zip -qr Jarvis-unsigned.ipa Payload
unzip -t Jarvis-unsigned.ipa
python3 scripts/verify_app_icon.py --ipa Jarvis-unsigned.ipa --asset-info-output app-icon-assets.json

python3 -c "from pathlib import Path; import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'scripts'); import jarvis_release; jarvis_release.validate_ipa(Path('Jarvis-unsigned.ipa'),9009)"
shasum -a 256 Jarvis-unsigned.ipa > IPA-SHA256SUMS
